title: Scope 12 web tools on by default, hooks, and /share, /bug, /changelog
note: Paired clean native builds: base origin/develop 4703b27537 in its own worktree, candidate 062aecb209. Standard suite, 7 models, 3 trials, 336/336 successful. The model-visible change is web_search and web_fetch joining the default tools by owner decision: about 600 more characters of tool definitions in every request (toolSchemaChars 4.1-4.3k to 4.7-4.9k); the system prompt is unchanged. No sample called either web tool, and failures, requests, and tool errors are unchanged. The flagged total-token rises, claude-opus-5-5 +8.2%, claude-sonnet-5-5 +9.7%, and gemini-4-argon-high +9.0% (the other models +2 to +5%, intervals spanning zero for four), are the cost of the definitions and are accepted as the owner's on-by-default choice. Hooks run only when configured and /share, /bug, and /changelog send nothing to the model, so neither changes this suite's requests. No scenario exercises web search or fetch; live print-mode runs on the CLIProxyAPI route called both and answered with a cited URL.

settings.effort: each route's effort is in routes: medium by default, DeepSeek high (it has no medium), and an EVAL_MODELS @<effort> replaces either

regressionRule: all tasks, per model: total tokens with the 95% interval above zero; requests up more than 10% with the 95% interval above zero; failures +2 or more; any tool-error increase
